name: Repeating tracks folded to one period

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: wasm/web with headed Playwright and WebGPU enabled
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Repeating tracks folded to one period Hypothesis

Looping animations of different lengths play over the least common multiple of their lengths (thunder.svg: 7 s, 3 s and 1.11 s over 777 s), each unrolled into thousands of keyframes the graph held as breakpoints. A track whose keyframes repeat at a period (times a period apart, same values and easings, whole repetitions, no jump at a repetition's edge; a repetition's end the next start repeats is dropped first) becomes one repetition read at `(clamp(t) - start) mod period`.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** periodic folding in `Graph::track`/`color_track`. **Allowed:** `graph.rs`, new test file, docs. **Forbidden:** importer changes, sampling elsewhere.
